notes.title: Update ver.01.02 released. (2015/12/03)
notes.notes:
An update has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart the game. 

* The following items have been modified/improved:
　- You are able to delegate rights to each Daimyō when playing multiple Daimyōs.
　- You are able to easily make the cut-in screen show up by entering "Space" or "Tab" key during the demo play.
　- Other minor issues.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Tenshouki WPK HD Version / with HD Version
notes.notes:
NOBUNAGA'S AMBITION: Tenshouki WPK HD Version / with HD Version is Now Available on Steam!

The 6th release of the "Nobunaga's Ambition" historical simulation game series has been reborn at the STEAM store as "Tenshouki with Power-up Kit HD Version." Players become the rulers of their clans and aim to unify the country under their leadership. Players will enjoy all the distinctive NA game elements, including a learning system, battle system, and an army system.
